summary: Phase 10 micro-revision backend testing complete. Added /app/backend/tests/test_phase10.py with 15 invariants covering backdated returns, returned_stock historical invoices, returned_stock validation, opening_balance_date for customers & suppliers, and smoke regression. ALL 15 new tests pass. Full regression suite (Phase 7 + 8/9 + 10) = 48/48 passing. One MINOR contract inconsistency flagged: /api/reports/customer-ledger filters pre-opening-date transactions correctly but does NOT echo `opening_balance_date` in its response, while /api/reports/supplier-ledger does. Spec says both should return it.

minor.issue: Response missing `opening_balance_date` field. Filtering by opening_balance_date works correctly (pre-date entries excluded), but the field itself is not echoed back. Supplier-ledger correctly returns it. Spec: 'customer-ledger and supplier-ledger endpoints return it'. Fix: add `opening_balance_date: opening_date` to the returned dict in routes/reports.py customer_ledger() (mirror lines 692 in supplier_ledger).

action_items: Add `opening_balance_date` to customer-ledger response payload in /app/backend/routes/reports.py customer_ledger() — single-line fix mirroring supplier_ledger at line 692.
critical_code_review_comments: invoices.py update_invoice() rebuilds items WITHOUT preserving source/returned_stock_id/cost_price — editing a historical mixed-source invoice will lose the returned_stock linkage and miscalculate profit. Not covered by current spec but a latent bug.
invoices.py create_invoice() does not release reserved returned_stock if a later DB write fails — partial failure could leave quantity_used incremented with no invoice. Low risk in practice.
Returned-stock validation (>available) correctly returns 400 with descriptive message.
seed_data_creation: All test data created with TEST_ prefixed names + uuid hex suffix to avoid collisions. No cleanup performed (matches existing test pattern in test_phase7/8_9).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_phase10.py (15 tests). Run combined regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase7.py /app/backend/tests/test_phase8_9.py /app/backend/tests/test_phase10.py — 48/48 passing as of this iteration. Single minor gap: customer-ledger missing opening_balance_date echo (filtering works). Frontend was explicitly out of scope.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Minor field-echo gap in customer-ledger is a missing line in routes/reports.py customer_ledger() return dict; the variable `opening_date` is already loaded at line 546.
